raw_evidence_manifest.scope: All supported data, image, video, documentation, and thermal-event files under the eight direct-language run roots plus command-probe, semantic-scoring, and thermal-log roots.

supporting_evidence_manifest.scope: Calibration, excluded thermal/GPU-role/oracle runs, the excluded Cosmos GPU0 command probe, and separately labeled retrospective Efficient-WAM, FastWAM, LingBot-VA, Cosmos, and pi0.5 evidence.

checkpoint_provenance.aggregate_digest_definition: SHA-256 of the sorted sha256sum output for every included regular file. Hugging Face snapshot symlinks are followed. Absolute local paths are part of the aggregate input, so these digests pin this evidence host rather than serving as portable model-distribution checksums.

cosmos_confirmation_snapshot.interpretation: The policy server fits with approximately 14.4 GiB allocated on one 24 GiB card; the simulator separately uses approximately 7.9 GiB. The simulator card reported software thermal slowdown at this instant but remained below the 87 C proactive pause threshold and the 90 C emergency stop threshold. No hardware thermal slowdown was active. Wall-time measurements, temperatures, throttling state, and cooling pauses are reported rather than hidden.
cosmos_confirmation_snapshot.measurement_context: Valid canonical confirmation batch during a Cosmos3 Edge policy request, after the frozen thermal guard was introduced. Physical GPU 1 served the policy with decoded futures; physical GPU 0 ran the RoboLab Isaac Sim client. This is a steady-state point measurement, not a peak-memory measurement.

cosmos_excluded_initial_snapshot.driver_workaround: Isaac Sim's Vulkan parser displayed 535.53.01 because the three-digit driver minor overflowed its field, so the run used --/rtx/verifyDriverVersion/enabled=false after host nvidia-smi verified 535.309.01. The rejected startup produced no policy requests and is excluded separately.

gpus.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090
gpus.role: Cosmos3 Edge DROID policy server with video decoding

cosmos_excluded_initial_snapshot.measurement_context: Cosmos3 Edge policy server on physical GPU 0 while the RoboLab Isaac Sim confirmation client ran on physical GPU 1. This is a live steady-state snapshot during a policy request, not a maximum-memory measurement.

cosmos_gpu_assignment_audit.claim_boundary: This comparison isolates the physical inference card only. It does not test simulator/render GPU assignment. The definitive Cosmos probe and all definitive Cosmos rollouts use policy GPU 1; GPU0 probe outputs are retained as supporting provenance.
cosmos_gpu_assignment_audit.interpretation: All action NPY and future MP4 files match exactly across physical policy GPUs for the same input bytes, prompts, and seed. The earlier cross-role rollout difference is therefore attributable to simulator/render input variation, not a detected numerical policy-card effect.
cosmos_gpu_assignment_audit.purpose: Quantify physical-policy-GPU sensitivity using the exact same frozen observation, 16 prompts, and request seed. These distances are not steerability evidence.

closed_loop.initial_state_schema_interpretation: Physical reset identity hashes only articulation/ and rigid_object/ arrays. The full recorder group is retained separately because Cosmos records two additional camera poses that pi0.5 does not request.
closed_loop.paper_progression_operationalization: persistent correct-cube OBJECT_GRABBED_SUCCESS plus RoboLab requested-side success, which requires the final 45-degree relation and gripper detachment; each item contributes one half
closed_loop.relation_only_progression_operationaliza: persistent correct-cube pickup plus final requested relation regardless of gripper detachment; declared secondary diagnostic
closed_loop.strict_progression_operationalization: pickup credit plus a requested-relation false-to-true transition after pickup that remains true at the final recorded state

trajectory_evidence.all_episode_policy: Render and index every one of the 160 registered direct-language episodes. No episode may be removed from the evidence gallery because it is visually inconvenient or contradicts the narrative.
trajectory_evidence.coordinate_convention: page x = -robot-frame y, so robot-left appears left; page y = robot-frame x (forward)
trajectory_evidence.illustrative_route_disclaimer: The dashed direct route is explanatory only and is not a scored or claimed ground-truth trajectory.
trajectory_evidence.scored_goal: released cube inside the requested RoboLab 45-degree horizontal cone

retrospective.claim: Efficient-WAM-RT is a usable research WAM for causal mid-rollout language interventions, not a generally reliable language controller.

cosmos3_edge_droid.action_schema: seven DROID joint-position targets plus gripper
cosmos3_edge_droid.claim_limit: One matched spatial pair and one model seed. Neutral right succeeded, neutral left failed, and both endpoints moved robot-right.

decision.reason: Fast one-3090 operation plus causal prompted endpoint shifts in all six matched pairs and two clean counterfactual successes.
decision.secondary_role: Stronger semantic imagined-future comparison and a promising fine-tuning substrate; default swaps are not yet successful.

efficient_wam.claim_limit: One expert-valid bell/bread scene; scene transfer remains unmeasured.

fastwam.implementation_finding: The release accepted text_cfg_scale but did not apply CFG in action-only or joint inference.

lingbot_va.evaluation_fix: Run one episode per subprocess because CuRobo CUDA-graph pools survive environment close.
lingbot_va.memory_fix: Share one frozen VAE weight set across two independent streaming-cache wrappers.

paper_inspired_hierarchical_gate.interpretation: The model can redirect an already-grasped object from an identical trajectory prefix, but control depends sharply on command abstraction and direction. A timed abstraction carousel is not a substitute for the paper's competent visual high-level reasoner.
paper_inspired_hierarchical_gate.source: Chen et al., Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies for Embodied Reasoning and Hierarchical Control, arXiv:2602.13193

pi05_droid_vla.claim_limit: One neutral scene, two canonical samples and one short-form sample per direction. Canonical right succeeds at the task predicate but only one run records a pickup; left fails, action effect is below repeat noise, and short right reverses direction.
